_notes: The sprites UQM's own DrawSystem stamps in a system's views, for every star, in the order it draws them: each stamp is [sheet, frame, x, y, colour table entry]. Sheets: 2 the worlds' images (graphics.planets), 3 the orbit background (graphics.orbitbackground: 16 the starbase, 17 a shielded planet in its inner view, 19 the Sa-Matra), 5 the sun (graphics.truespacesun). The entry is the colour table entry set for the stamp (colortable.orbplan's for a world, colortable.truespace's for the sun), -1 for the orbit background.
outer: the outer view at each zoom (8192 to 1024), after ValidateOrbits. inner: each planet's inner view, after enterInnerSystem and ValidateInnerOrbits.
background: the SHA-256 of CreateStarBackGround's stamps (all from the orbit background), each as little-endian 16-bit frame, x, y.
Code only: frames are numbers; nothing is read from the content.
